CurrentIssues.ID: ClassOrdering:NdefRecord.kt$NdefRecord$/** * The MIME type of the record, if it has one. * * This returns [type] as a string if [tnf] is [Tnf.MIME_MEDIA]. * The payload of the record is returned in [payload]. */ val mimeType: String? get() { if (tnf == Tnf.MIME_MEDIA) { return type.decodeToString() } return null }

ClassOrdering:NdefRecord.kt$NdefRecord$/** * The URI of record, if one can be found. * * The following records are supported: * - Records with [Tnf.ABSOLUTE_URI] * - [Tnf.WELL_KNOWN] with type [com.sphereon.data.link.nfc.model.NfcConst.RTD_URI] * - [Tnf.WELL_KNOWN] with type [com.sphereon.data.link.nfc.model.NfcConst.RTD_SMART_POSTER] and containing a URI record in the NDEF message nested in the * payload. * * If this is not a URI record by the above rules, `null` is returned. */ val uri: String? get() = getUri(false)
